winner.premise: A woman thinks her new neighbor keeps stealing her delivered packages, so she sets a harmless decoy box outside her door and discovers the real culprit is her own boyfriend secretly retrieving deliveries to hide an expensive surprise hobby purchase.
winner.conflict: After several packages vanish minutes after delivery, the narrator becomes convinced the new neighbor across the hall is stealing them, while her boyfriend keeps dismissing her suspicions and urging her not to confront anyone.
winner.twist: The boyfriend has been collecting the packages himself because one delivery contains a costly pottery wheel he bought for the narrator after months of quietly saving for it, and the neighbor was actually bringing misdelivered parcels back.
winner.hook: I was completely sure my new neighbor was stealing my packages, so I left one outside my door just to catch her.
winner.narration:
For two weeks, deliveries kept disappearing from outside my apartment. The tracking app would say delivered, I would get home twenty minutes later, and the hallway would be empty. It happened with skincare, a phone case, even a boring box of laundry pods. The weird part was that it started right after a new woman moved into the unit across from us.

I told my boyfriend I wanted to ask building management for the camera footage. He immediately said I was overreacting. Every time I mentioned the neighbor, he defended her even though he claimed they had barely spoken. That made me more suspicious, not less.

Then one evening I saw her carrying a box with the same delivery company's tape. She looked at me, quickly went into her apartment, and shut the door. I decided I needed proof before accusing anyone.

The next morning, I put an empty shipping box outside our door. Inside, I left a note that said, 'Smile. I know where this box belongs.' I went downstairs, sat in the lobby with coffee, and watched our doorbell camera on my phone.

Ten minutes later, my boyfriend appeared in the hallway. He looked both directions, grabbed the decoy box, and hurried toward the stairwell.

I called him immediately. He froze so hard on camera that I almost laughed. I asked why he was stealing our own packages. He sighed and told me to come upstairs.

Inside our storage room were every missing delivery, unopened. Behind them was one enormous box covered with a blanket. He pulled it off and revealed a pottery wheel. Months earlier, I had mentioned that I missed making pottery but could never justify buying the equipment. He had been saving quietly and ordered the wheel for my birthday. When my smaller deliveries started arriving around the same time, he hid those too because he was terrified I would open the storage room and discover the surprise.

Then someone knocked. It was the neighbor. She was holding another package addressed to me that the courier had left at her door by mistake. She smiled and said, 'This keeps happening, so I figured I'd bring it over again.'

I looked at my boyfriend, then at the decoy box still in his hands. The person I had been preparing to accuse was literally returning my package, while the actual package thief was standing inside my apartment.

My boyfriend lifted the empty box and said, 'Technically, I was stealing from us for you.'

I had spent two weeks investigating the wrong suspect.
winner.title: I Set a Trap for My Package Thief
winner.description: Her packages keep vanishing, and the new neighbor seems like the obvious suspect. So she sets a harmless trap to finally catch the thief—only for the camera to reveal someone she never expected. A relatable relationship mystery with an awkward twist and a surprisingly sweet payoff. #shorts #storytime #relationship #funny #drama
winner.payoff: I had spent two weeks investigating the wrong suspect.
